confirmed_findings.title: Specific finished-goods mass gate omits measured postrelease phase exits
confirmed_findings.description: Q and full unallocated FG physical V use actual net as-received mass. Fine-gold and dry-metal mass are expressly separate subaccounts, not Q. The general c_physical identity includes external/species exits, but its specific FG equality only includes closing FG, gross shipments and service rejects. A1kg newly first-released solid offcut lot with0.01kg retained moisture (not separately excluded liquid), accepted under its declared receiver moisture criterion, can remain in permitted storage and lose0.01kg measured water vapour. With no dispatch, return or service reject, closing FG is0.99kg: the specific equality gives1=.99 while the correct gross gate gives1=.99+.01. There is no dry-metal-only antecedent or explicit companion phase term in the stated FG equality.

Preserve unique first release/Qc, actual physical stocks and separate burden convention. Align both languages and regenerate projection.
